referents.why: for them (autois) is plural; the crowd (w3) is a collective singular that takes plural agreement and is the only candidate that can receive Pilate's custom
he did for them: the custom is Pilate's (verse 6), masculine singular; the builder's w5 (to beg) is an infinitive, not a person

links.why: participle having cried out is nested in the main act of the crowd
infinitive to beg is the complement of began, nested in cl0; not a purpose
kathos (just as) he did for them: a comparison in a prepositional role
